TaskDescription: Air puffs (~60 ms, clinical tonometer, Keeler Pulsair intelliPuff) were delivered to the left eye while eye closure was filmed at 200 frames/s. Sessions (BIDS ses label = DANDI session label): puffBaseline / puffPreinfusion = eyepuff series before ketamine; puffInfusion = during a 40-min 0.5 mg/kg continuous ketamine infusion; puffPostinfusion (and puffPostinfusionfast, SD211) = after the infusion; puffControl = control series (the article describes an unexpected-auditory control in which the puff device sounded but was directed away from the participant). Each recording is the 20-min window the authors exported: per the source session_description, '10min pre and post puff start'.

AntiAliasingLowPass.Description: FIR anti-aliasing low-pass applied by the authors before downsampling to 200 Hz; cut-off not documented

Downsampling.Description: downsampled by the authors to 200 Hz from the acquisition rate (not documented in the release)

iEEGReference: not documented in the release (monopolar contact labels; the article re-referenced to a bipolar montage for its analyses, which is NOT applied to these series)
ElectrodeManufacturersModelName: sEEG depth electrodes, 12-16 platinum contacts, 0.86 mm diameter, 2.29 mm contact height, 3-5 mm centre-to-centre spacing (article Methods)
iEEGPlacementScheme: clinically determined sEEG trajectories (article: 'determined by individual clinical need')
SourceSessionDescription: Voltage traces of multichannel SEEG around eyepuffs, 10min pre and post puff start
